title: Implement SCALE as an optional shared CUDA-compatibility backend
goal: Allow explicitly admitted CUDA-oriented workloads to use Spectral Compute SCALE on supported AMD GPUs without making CUDA a capability, without application-local CUDA cores, and without silent fallback.
requirements: SCALE is a shared backend adapter, not a capability.

The central shared compatibility implementation must be available through one common entry point to every current and future CFA3 application; per-application backend cores and access allowlists are forbidden.
AMD device binding must use live exact PCI identity from SCALE discovery.
SCALE execution must be license-rights gated and disabled without a valid receipt.
No automatic SCALE install, scaleenv activation, PATH mutation, driver mutation or package mutation.
Translation execution must be explicitly allowed by workload policy.
HRB remains the placement and lease authority.
Intel support must not be claimed while upstream SCALE support is unavailable.
Native NVIDIA CUDA remains available independently and is not replaced by SCALE.
No silent backend, device, provider or cloud fallback.
Physical Current Host or target-host evidence is required before runtime promotion.
Capability baseline remains 175 with no new architectural authority.
